loanTypes.text: Funding to buy, refinance or unlock value in commercial property.

loanTypes.title: Corporate finance
loanTypes.text: Flexible funding for businesses with property or other assets behind them.

why.title: We move quickly
why.text: When an opportunity will not wait, neither do we. Most loans settle within 7 to 14 days of your first enquiry.

why.title: We look at the whole picture
why.text: We take the time to understand your project, not just tick boxes.

why.title: You deal with real people
why.text: You will speak directly with our team from your first call to settlement.

approval.title: Initial review
approval.text: Our lending team checks the deal fits our lending criteria.

approval.title: Professional valuation
approval.text: Every property is professionally valued, and we lend against the lower of the purchase price or the valuation.

approval.title: Due diligence
approval.text: We check the borrower, the security and the plan to repay.

approval.title: Credit committee decision
approval.text: The committee approves, declines or sets conditions.
